name: Communicating—Part 1: The Model
notes: Understand Aristotle’s Model of Communication; State the parts of Aristotle’s Model of Communication | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 1

name: Finding Your Vision
notes: Define vision as what future success looks like; Understand the difference between a team vision and personal visions | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 1

name: Planning
notes: Understand the value of planning as a step to reaching goals and fulfilling; Plan an event or activity using the 7-Step Planning Process tool | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 1

name: Setting Your Goals
notes: Explain what a goal is; Describe and use the SMART Goals tool | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 1

name: Developing Your Team
notes: See that a team is a group of people working toward the same goals and vision; Describe the phases that any team will experience as members move toward | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 3

name: Scouting EDGE
notes: Explain the elements of EDGE; Match the steps of EDGE with the stages of team development | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 3

name: Solving Problems
notes: Define the types of problems you leaders typically face; Describe how to determine the correct problem to solve | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 2

name: Ethics and Values in Decision-making
notes: Give a definition for “ethics” and discuss the importance of ethical decision; Describe three kinds of decisions (Right vs. Wrong / Right vs. Right / Trivial) | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 5

name: Leading Yourself
notes: Discuss the importance of having a personal vision; Recognize at least one new way of thinking about themselves | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 4

name: Servant Leadership
notes: Define leadership; Understand the connection between values and leadership | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 4

name: Communicating—Part 5: The Story
notes: Understand that storytelling is a key element of effective communication and thus; is also critical to effective leadership | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 5

name: Diversity and Valuing People
notes: Define diversity; Recognize that similarities and differences we share with others can help groups | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 5

name: Resolving Conflicts
notes: Discuss several ways effective leaders can minimize conflict; Describe how to use EAR (Express, Address, Resolve) as a tool for resolving | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 5

name: Communicating—Part 6: Communicating with Adults
notes: Recognize the importance of effectively communicating with adults; Understand and demonstrate the five-step process for communicating with | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 5

name: Embracing and Leading Change
notes: Recognize that leading change can have positive impact; Understand the value of change and develop skills to lead it successfully | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 6

name: Resilience
notes: Define resilience; Recognize that resilience is critical to individual success | 26-1 observed: 60 min on day 6

name: Communicating—Part 2: The Sender
notes: Recognize the role of a sender is to communicate clearly; Understand the neutral position and how it affects communication | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 1

name: Communicating—Part 3: The Message
notes: Identify the message in a communication; Decide what information is important about the message | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 2

name: Communicating—Part 4: The Receiver
notes: Understand the importance of effective listening; Understand that good leadership requires effective listening | 26-1 observed: 30 min on day 4
